s1.desc: a room with a table crowded with plates of food in front of a plain pale grey wall

spans.notes: one continuous moving take over a table of food (iced drinks, syrupy pancakes, sushi, rice cakes, sandwiches) with Pax peeking from behind it; no static frame anywhere in the skit (per-frame phase shift 8-11 px/frame leftward, all depth bands alike). In f0-113 Pax is drawn out of focus (a soft depth-of-field blur on him and the back of the table) and only comes sharp at f114 (focus pull f70-113). A lens blur on the lead is not the flat Pudgy look: effect, which outranks camera_move

spans.view: with a stack of syrupy pancakes, sushi, rice cakes and a plate of sandwiches in front of him
spans.notes: Pax in focus from f114. Pan right with an upward drift: content moves 4-7 px/frame left and 3-4 px/frame down, slowing to a stop at f154 (unsure: a diagonal pan, the tilt-up part is real). Pax shows only from the shoulders up behind the table (partial). Otherwise keepable: no overlay | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v22): compound move: every depth band moves left and down together, about 6.5 px left and 4.3 px down per 2 frames (half-res) at f114-130, easing to a stop at f154: a pan right with a tilt up at two-thirds of its speed, plus a slow zoom (affine scale ~1.0025 per 4 frames). Under the Compound moves ruling this is camera other and unfilled
turnaround of the pan, under 1.5 px/frame f154-157 (4 frames)

verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v22): compound move: accelerating pan left with a strong push-in (affine scale 1.005 -> 1.019 per 4 frames, about 16% overall), unfilled per the Compound moves ruling; Pax nibbles the sandwiches, bites, then straightens up

spans.view: with plates of sushi, rice cakes and a stack of syrupy pancakes in front of him

beats.text: Pax looks ahead from behind the plates of food with raised brows and a worried frown
Pax stares ahead with heavy-lidded, unimpressed eyes from behind the plates of food

spans.notes: pan left accelerating from ~2 px/frame at f159 to ~12 px/frame at the end (content moves right, little vertical drift); never settles. An iced drink re-enters the foreground at the left from about f245. Pax in focus throughout, shoulders up behind the table (partial). Otherwise keepable: no overlay | verification pass 2 (verify_v10_report_v22): f158-213 is a compound move: the pan left accelerates while the camera pushes in hard (isotropic affine scale 1.005 -> 1.019 per 4 frames in every band, about 16% overall; a 16-frame affine fit gives cc 0.999 vs 0.674 for translation only). Split off as camera_move with camera other, unfilled; the speed changes abruptly at f214 (zoom drops to a steady ~1.0044 per 4 frames), so f214-292 is its own
